title: Redux in Real-World Applications
description: Apply Redux to real-world scenarios including project structure, authentication, error handling, and deployment.
longDescription: Theory meets practice in this final module. You'll learn recommended project structures that scale, implement a complete authentication flow, handle errors gracefully with middleware, prepare for production deployment, and add offline support with Redux Persist. These patterns prepare you to use Redux confidently in production applications.
whatYouLearn: Organize Redux code with feature folders
Add offline support with Redux Persist
